claim: UPLIFT: investigator ORR 15.6% (95% CI 10.0-22.7%) in NaPi2b-positive (TPS>=75%, n=141); lower CI bound did not exclude the 12% ORR of single-agent chemotherapy.
UPLIFT efficacy failed to replicate the ~100-patient phase 1b dose-expansion data (sponsor statement).
UPLIFT overall ORR 13.1%; no indication that NaPi2b positivity (TPS>=75%) enriched for response.
UPLIFT population: median 3 prior lines (31% had 4), 69% prior PARP inhibitor, 84% prior bevacizumab.
Upifitamab rilsodotin was placed on partial clinical hold over risk of bleeding events.
TUB-040 phase 1 (ESMO): confirmed ORR 50%, unconfirmed 60% across dose levels, irrespective of target antigen expression.
TUB-040: NaPi2b-directed ADC carrying eight topoisomerase-I inhibitor payloads on a stable, cleavable linker (Tubutecan).
ASCENT-07: TOP1-inhibitor ADC moved to first chemotherapy line in HR+/HER2- mBC did not meet PFS (median 8.3 vs 8.3 months).
